title: Sarbacher picks up Townsend Brown after the Paris experiment

tellings.quote: Well, in in 1956 when Thomas Townsen Brown does his um experiment in Paris proving the Biffield Brown effect and that this this works in a vacuum and I think showing some sort of interesting coupling between electromagnetism and gravity. he uh comes back to the US and he's picked up in a black Cadillac by Robert Sarbacher

plain: Jesse Michels says that in 1956 the inventor Thomas Townsend Brown ran an experiment in Paris showing that the Biefeld-Brown effect, a push produced by high-voltage electricity, works even in a vacuum, hinting at a link between electromagnetism and gravity. When Brown came back to the US, Michels says, he was picked up in a black Cadillac by Robert Sarbacher, a government scientist. Michels tells it himself, without naming a source, as a sign that officials quietly took an interest in work that might lead to anti-gravity.
